cases.name: with_companies
cases.prompt:
You classify document attachments for an accounts-payable mailbox.
Decide whether the attached PDF or image is an invoice or tax invoice that should be processed for payment.
Purchase orders, statements, remittance advices, receipts with no amount due, quotes, reports, marketing material,
logos, and unrelated documents are not invoices. Do not guess.

Email subject: Invoice 42 from Acme
Email sender: Acme Pty Ltd <ap@acme.example.test>

Return ONLY JSON using this shape:
{
  "is_invoice": true or false,
  "classification_reason": "short factual reason",
  "classification_confidence": number from 0 to 1,
  "invoice_no": "invoice number or null",
  "vendor": "vendor/supplier company name or null",
  "company": "which TriCab entity the invoice is billed TO — see the entity list below; null if none of them",
  "vendor_email": "the supplier's contact or remittance email printed on the invoice or null",
  "tax_id": "ABN or tax ID number or null",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
  "po_number": "purchase order number or null",
  "currency": "3-letter currency code or null",
  "net_amount": numeric value or null,
  "tax_amount": numeric value or null,
  "total_amount": numeric value or null,
  "notes": "important notes or extraction warnings"
}

The invoice is billed to one of these TriCab entities. For `company`, return one of these names copied EXACTLY, or null.
- TriCab (Australia) Pty Ltd  (formerly Cable Co Pty Ltd; sites: Sydney depot; Brisbane yard)
- TriCab NZ Limited
- TriCab Singapore Pte Ltd  (sites: Tuas)
- TriCab Holdings
Spelling noise -- case, brackets, missing spaces, PTY/P/L/LTD/LIMITED, ACN or ABN suffixes -- does not make it a different entity. A TriCab depot, branch or site named in the delivery or bill-to block identifies the entity that operates it, even when the legal name never appears: freight invoices often say only the site. A former name identifies the entity it was renamed from, but match the WHOLE former name -- an unrelated supplier may share one word of it. But do not guess: return null if the document names no entity and no known site, names only "TriCab" with no country or site, or names more than one entity.
